senses.example: Aparco el coche cerca de casa.
senses.exampleGloss: I park the car near home.

alternatives.reason: LatAm car sense; in Spain carro is a cart, so it is never taught as a vehicle here.
Formal/administrative register; correct but stiff in speech.

notes: coche is the single normal Peninsular word; pairing it with aparcar fixes both at once.
